jobs.title: Privacy policy
jobs.description: Legal Privacy Policy Learn how Marketeam.ai collects, uses, and protects your data. Introduction At Marketeam.ai, we are committed to collecting, maintaining, and securing your personal information in accordance with this Privacy Policy, as well as applicable laws, rules, and regulations. This policy applies to personal information collected from Marketeam online resources and communications (such as our website, email, applications, and other online tools) that display a link to this policy. “Personally Identifiable Information” (“PII”) is information that can be used on its own or with other information to identify, contact, or locate a single person, or to identify an individual in context. While using the Website or using any of the services offered through it, including contacting Us, You may be requested to provide information, including PII. You are not legally required to provide PII, however in the event you refuse to provide your PII, We may be unable to allow in order to enable you to access and use the services on Our Website. By using the Website You hereby acknowledge, agree and explicitly consent of your own free will and although not necessarily required to do so under law, that your PII, will be stored, processed, used, held and managed by Us and/or on our behalf, inter alia, by magnetic or optical means that are designated for digital processing or in other forms of database(s) in accordance with applicable law for the purposes and in the manner described herein below in this Privacy Policy. Please read our Privacy Policy carefully to get a clear understanding of how we organize, collect, use, protect or otherwise handle your PII in accordance with our website and the Services we provide. This Privacy Policy may be occasionally updated. If We make any substantial changes in the manner we use Your Personal Information, then We will provide a proper notice. Information We Collect and Use Customer Support and Inquiries: We collect personal information such as your first and last name, email address, telephone number, and other contact details when you submit requests regarding our products or services or contact us for support. This information is used solely for the purpose of responding to your inquiries. Marketing and Promotional Purposes: We collect personal information like your name, company, address, email address, and telephone number when you subscribe to our newsletter or engage with our marketing materials. We collect this information only with your explicit, informed consent, and you may opt-out at any time. By providing Marktrix your email address you consent to our using the email address to send you Service-related notices, including any notices required by law, in lieu of communication by postal mail. If you do not want to receive such email messages, you may opt out or change your preferences in your Account Page. Opting out may prevent you from receiving email messages regarding updates and/or service improvements. Website and Service Improvement: We use personal information such as web server logs, IP addresses, cookies, and web beacons to administer and enhance our website and services. This information helps us to improve functionality and user engagement. Cookies and Tracking Technologies: We utilize cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies to understand your preferences and enhance your experience on our site. Explicit consent is required for the use of such technologies, and you can modify your preferences at any time. We have not sold consumer information for any monetary value. However, our use of cookies, advertising and tracking technologies may be a “sale” under certain U.S. state consumer privacy laws. This use of tracking technologies may also constitute “sharing” under certain U.S. state consumer privacy laws. ​ Legal Basis for Processing You are not legally required to provide PII, however our processing of your personal information is based on the necessity to fulfill our service commitments to you, to comply with legal requirements, and to pursue our legitimate interests in improving our services and offerings. You hereby acknowledge, agree and explicitly consent of your own free will and although not necessarily required to do so under law, that your PII, will be stored, processed, used, held and managed by us and/or on our behalf, inter alia, by magnetic or optical means that are designated for digital processing or in other forms of database(s) in accordance with applicable law. Data Security We implement robust security measures to prevent unauthorized access, use, or disclosure of your personal information. Our security protocols include: Advanced Encryption: Use of state-of-the-art encryption technology to secure data transmissions and storage. Access Controls: Limiting access to personal information to authorized personnel who need to know in order to perform their job functions. Regular Security Audits: Conducting regular security assessments to identify and mitigate potential security vulnerabilities. It is, however, your personal responsibility to ensure that the computer you are using is adequately secured and protected against malicious software, such as trojans, computer viruses, and worm programs. You are aware of the fact that without adequate security measures (e.g. secure web browser configuration, up-to-date antivirus software, personal firewall software, no usage of software from dubious sources) there is a risk that the data and passwords you use to protect access to your data, could be disclosed to unauthorized third parties. For more information about Marketeam’s Data Security, visit our Data Security Principles page. Data Protection Officer (DPO) We have appointed a Data Protection Officer to oversee our data security and compliance. jobs.title: AI transparency
jobs.description: Legal AI Transparency How Marketeam.ai uses AI, and what to expect from it We are committed to being transparent about how artificial intelligence (AI) is used within our platform. This page explains which AI services we use, how they are applied, and what users should expect when interacting with AI-powered features. AI Services We Use Most features on our platform are powered by proprietary AI models hosted on our own infrastructure, which guarantees data isolation and prevents cross‑contamination between users or workloads. In addition, to provide our services, we use third-party AI technologies. ​ These include: Google's Gemini Models via Vertex AI Google's Veo Models via Vertex AI Google's Imagen Models via Vertex AI Anthropic's Claude Models via Vertex AI Anthropic's Claude Models via Anthropic API OpenAI's GPT Models via OpenAI's API These services process user inputs to generate outputs, automate functionality, and support core features of the platform. We use these providers only as needed to deliver our services. Their processing of data is governed by their respective terms and privacy policies. ​ How We Use AI AI is used to support and enhance our product experience. This may include: Generating and editing content Summarizing or analyzing information Automating workflows and repetitive tasks Providing suggestions, insights, or recommendations Powering user-facing assistance features ​ AI is used as a supportive tool and not as a substitute for human judgment. Human Oversight We design our systems to include human oversight where appropriate. Users are responsible for reviewing AI-generated outputs before relying on them, particularly for decisions involving financial,legal, medical, or other sensitive matters. ​ Limitations of AI AI systems are inherently probabilistic and may produce inaccurate or incomplete results. Outputs may: Contain errors or misleading information Reflect outdated or insufficient data Vary depending on input and context ​ You should not rely solely on AI-generated outputs without independent verification. ​ Data and Privacy We take reasonable measures to limit unnecessary data sharing and handle data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For more information, please refer to our Privacy Policy. We do not use user data to train AI models. ​ Responsible AI Use We are committed to using AI responsibly and in a way that aligns with the following principles: Safety Fairness Transparency Human control ​ Ongoing Improvements We continuously evaluate and improve how AI is used within our platform, including monitoring performance, updating safeguards, and adapting to evolving standards and expectations. ​ Contact If you have questions about our use of AI, or if you encounter incorrect, harmful, or unexpected behavior, please contact us.
